```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
# Read in the cleaned data
load('../data/biomarker-clean.RData')
```

```{r}
# Get the variable names of the raw data for comparison
var_names <- read_csv('../data/biomarker-raw.csv', 
                     col_names = F, 
                     n_max = 2, 
                     col_select = -(1:2)) %>%
  t() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(name = V1, 
         abbreviation = V2) %>%
  na.omit()

# Read in the raw data
biomarker_raw <- read_csv('../data/biomarker-raw.csv', 
         skip = 2,
         col_select = -2L,
         col_names = c('group', 
                       'empty',
                       pull(var_names, abbreviation),
                       'ados'),
         na = c('-', '')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group))
```

```{r}
# Re-create the preprocessing steps

# Trim outliers
trim <- function(x, .at){
  x[abs(x) > .at] <- sign(x[abs(x) > .at])*.at
  return(x)
}

# Separate each step in data transformation
# Log10 transform
biomarker_log <- biomarker_raw %>%
  mutate(across(.cols = -c(group, ados), 
                ~ log10(.x)))

# Log10 + Scale
biomarker_log_scaled <- biomarker_raw %>%
  mutate(across(.cols = -c(group, ados), 
                ~ scale(log10(.x))[, 1]))

# Log10 + Scale + Trim
biomarker_log_scaled_trimmed <- biomarker_log_scaled %>%
  mutate(across(.cols = -c(group, ados), 
                ~ trim(.x, .at = 3)))
```

```{r}
# Prepare data at different stages of preprocessing
# Pick a protein to visualize
protein <- "IRF1"

df_raw <- biomarker_raw %>% 
  select(group, all_of(protein)) %>% 
  mutate(stage = "1. Raw")

df_log <- biomarker_log %>% 
  select(group, all_of(protein)) %>% 
  mutate(stage = "2. Log10")

df_scaled <- biomarker_log_scaled %>% 
  select(group, all_of(protein)) %>% 
  mutate(stage = "3. Log10 + Scaled")

df_trimmed <- biomarker_log_scaled_trimmed %>% 
  select(group, all_of(protein)) %>% 
  mutate(stage = "4. Log10 + Scaled + Trimmed")

comparison_df <- bind_rows(df_raw, df_log, df_scaled, df_trimmed) %>%
  mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = c("1. Raw", 
                                          "2. Log10", 
                                          "3. Log10 + Scaled", 
                                          "4. Log10 + Scaled + Trimmed")))
```

```{r}
# Plot the distributions at each stage
ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = !!sym(protein), fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~stage, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = paste("Distribution of", protein, "at Each Preprocessing Stage"),
    x = "Value",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Group"
  )
```

```{r}
# Show the impact of the trimming function
df_before_trim <- biomarker_log_scaled %>% 
  select(-group, -ados) %>% 
  as.matrix()

df_after_trim <- biomarker_log_scaled_trimmed %>% 
  select(-group, -ados) %>% 
  as.matrix()

# Calculate total number of data points
total_points <- sum(!is.na(df_before_trim))

# Find how many points were outside the +/- 3 threshold
trimmed_points <- sum(abs(df_before_trim) > 3, na.rm = TRUE)
percent_trimmed <- (trimmed_points / total_points) * 100

# Print the findings (these are the results for your report)
cat("Total protein measurements:", total_points, "\n")
cat("Measurements trimmed (value > 3 or < -3):", trimmed_points, "\n")
cat("Percentage of data trimmed:", round(percent_trimmed, 4), "%\n")
```

```{r}
# Visualize the impact of trimming
trim_df <- tibble(
  value_before_trim = as.vector(df_before_trim),
  value_after_trim = as.vector(df_after_trim)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value_before_trim))

# Scatterplot
ggplot(trim_df, aes(x = value_before_trim, y = value_after_trim)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  # Add a reference line
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  # Add lines showing the trimming threshold
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-3, 3), color = "blue", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-3, 3), color = "blue", linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(
    title = "Impact of trimming on All Protein Data",
    x = "Value Before Trimming (Scaled)",
    y = "Value After Trimming (Scaled)"
  )
```
